summary: Repaired TextGen control-plane planning and execution to use structured Windows batch launcher metadata instead of nested PowerShell shell strings.
batch_execution_behavior: Structured windows_batch operations render to cmd.exe /d /c <launcher> plus separate argument list, use shell=false, and pass the manifest working directory as cwd.
textgen_command_behavior: Dry-run and execution plans show textgen.bat launched from A:\AI\TextGen\textgen-4.9 with Qwen3-8B-Q6_K.gguf substituted as the --model argument.
model_name_safety_behavior: Model names must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._+-]+$ and may not contain traversal or path separators; arguments are passed as list elements without shell-string interpolation.
health_check_preservation: Execution still succeeds only after http://127.0.0.1:5000/v1/models responds; endpoint failures return health_failed with diagnostics.
cli_behavior: ai-services load-model --service textgen --model Qwen3-8B-Q6_K.gguf --approved-by steward --health-timeout-seconds 20 --health-interval-seconds 2 --json remains the approved execution path.
